usage: smallsort-brief [-h] [--base-url BASE_URL] [--token-file TOKEN_FILE]
                       [--impersonate-service-account IMPERSONATE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT]
                       [--catalogue [LITERAL] | --search LITERAL | --file
                       FILE_ID] [--refresh] [--targeted-url TARGETED_URL]
                       [--info] [--value-start VALUE_START]
                       [--position POSITION] [--locate LITERAL]
                       [--near-position NEAR_POSITION] [--end END]
                       [--radius RADIUS] [--expect-sha256 EXPECT_SHA256]
                       [--unit {utf8-byte,unicode-codepoint}]
                       [--within FILE_ID] [--pointer POINTER] [--start START]
                       [--offset OFFSET]
                       build_id

Read Evidence Brief, or ask bounded follow-up questions through Reader. Reader
routes and the separate bounded targeted service are used. No direct GCS
access, proof runs, automatic pagination, cloud mutations, shell commands, or
credential output.

positional arguments:
  build_id              Cloud Build UUID

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --base-url BASE_URL
  --token-file TOKEN_FILE
                        existing owner-only identity-token file; never an
                        access token
  --impersonate-service-account IMPERSONATE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT
                        existing authorized caller identity; grants no IAM
                        permissions
  --catalogue [LITERAL]
  --search LITERAL
  --file FILE_ID
  --refresh             request an archived fragment through the separate
                        targeted service
  --targeted-url TARGETED_URL
                        administrator-provided targeted service HTTPS root
  --info                verified overview, counts and available selectors;
                        default for --refresh --file
  --value-start VALUE_START
                        decoded JSON string codepoint offset, with --refresh
                        --pointer
  --position POSITION   zero-based source position; requires --refresh and
                        --unit
  --locate LITERAL      find exact case-sensitive literal coordinates;
                        requires --refresh --file
  --near-position NEAR_POSITION
                        restrict --locate to +/-4096 units around a known
                        offset; requires --unit
  --end END             inclusive final line with --refresh --start; at most
                        12 lines
  --radius RADIUS       position window radius, 1 to 256 source units
  --expect-sha256 EXPECT_SHA256
                        require this archived file SHA before any source read
  --unit {utf8-byte,unicode-codepoint}
  --within FILE_ID      restrict --search to a catalogue file ID
  --pointer POINTER     JSON pointer (empty string selects root)
  --start START         original text line number, starting at 1
  --offset OFFSET       explicit next_offset from Reader or targeted
                        JSON/locator

Read Brief first. If facts are missing, use --catalogue or --search, then
--file with --pointer (JSON) or --start (text). Follow next_offset explicitly
with --offset. Coverage limits are not source absence.
